limitations: The meaning of 'sufficient width' remains unresolved; these requirements select no legal cutoff, formula, or compliance interpretation.

The source residue's assertion that lane width and declared vehicle width resolve the judgment is unsupported as an operational rule. These quantities are evidence inputs without a claim of sufficiency.
The summary's 'two lines of traffic' gloss is not an additional condition in the supplied law text.
Highway width and lane width depend on identified physical boundaries and measurement conventions; recording them does not settle the legal extent of the highway.
No simulator resource paths or capability documentation were supplied or inspected. Availability, precision, and completeness of the requested recordings are unverified.
No external reference was verified, so no coverage landmarks are supplied.
Observed overtaking actions do not establish satisfaction of the referenced overtaking laws; those requirements are not supplied here.
Obstruction geometry alone does not establish closure to traffic, and sign observations alone do not establish an official designation.
Sampling gaps and measurement uncertainty can limit reconstruction of movement and changing circumstances.
Recordings do not establish interior mental states, legal meaning, or every possible later predicate.
Sufficient width is a fixed synthetic scenario assumption, not a measured legal interpretation. Both actual3.5m lane widths and actual native vehicle width retained.
No other law is deliberately targeted; full source episode is delivered.
Actual half-occupancy uses every native body vertex and independently conservative Core boxes.
